$$
\begin{align*}
\text{Sum of degrees} &= 15 + 15 + 9 + 11 + 10 + 14 + 18 + 10 + 16 + 17 \\
&\quad + 9 + 16 + 15 + 20 + 10 + 11 + 20 + 16 + 11 + 10 \\
&\quad + 11 + 15 + 9 + 16 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 14 + 18 + 13 \\
&\quad + 19 + 16 + 15 + 17 + 12 + 10 + 9 + 7 + 14 + 14 \\
&= 528
\end{align*}
$$

---

### Step 2: Calculate Number of Edges

Since each edge is counted twice in the sum of degrees, the total number of edges is:

$$
\text{Number of edges} = \frac{\text{Sum of degrees}}{2} = \frac{528}{2} = 264
$$

---

### Final Answer

$$
\boxed{264}
$$
